externalPrerequisite.name: Superpowers
externalPrerequisite.verification: Install Superpowers from https://github.com/obra/superpowers, start a new Codex task in a checkout of https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort, and inspect the active skill inventory. Verify that the Superpowers brainstorming, writing-plans, test-driven-development, subagent-driven-development, requesting-code-review, and verification-before-completion SKILL.md entrypoints are present before running a positive case.

positiveCases.prompt: Implement this approved bounded Superpowers plan with balanced Adaptive Effort routing.
positiveCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Install and verify Superpowers as described above, start a new Codex task at the checkout root, approve a one-file documentation plan, then send the exact prompt.
positiveCases.expectedWorkflow: Dispatch one fresh inherited-model Low implementer.
positiveCases.expectedResult: A compact dispatch/result trace separates worker status from the downstream gate.
positiveCases.rationale: Balanced routes bounded implementation to Low.

positiveCases.prompt: Implement this approved multi-file Superpowers plan with deep Adaptive Effort routing.
positiveCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify Superpowers, start a new Codex task, and approve a plan that changes scripts/package_submission.py together with its archive-contract tests so genuine cross-file integration judgment is explicit; then send the exact prompt.
positiveCases.expectedWorkflow: Dispatch a fresh inherited-model Medium implementer only after classifying the task as integration work.
positiveCases.expectedResult: The compact trace records the Deep Medium integration route and the plan-owned boundary.
positiveCases.rationale: Cross-file contract judgment, not diff size alone, justifies the integration route.

positiveCases.scenario: After the Low implementer reports, run the checked-in local deterministic defect fixture once and return its exact classified output to the original worker.
positiveCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify Superpowers, start a new Codex task, approve a bounded test-first plan, and use the checked-in submission/fixtures/local-deterministic-defect.json fixture.

evidenceInjection.expectedOutput: {"actual":"medium","boundary":"bounded implementation route","classification":"local deterministic implementation defect","expected":"low","fingerprint":"review-fixture-local-v1","invariant":"Balanced bounded implementation uses Low effort"}
sequence: Run the exact command after the original Low worker reports and the downstream gate detects expected Low but actual Medium.
Copy the single output line and exit code 1 into a same-thread correction sent to the original worker.

positiveCases.expectedWorkflow: Send one same-thread correction to the original worker at its original effort.
positiveCases.expectedResult: One repair event cites the injected evidence, followed by separate worker and gate results.
positiveCases.rationale: The deterministic correction uses the single semantic allowance without a fresh worker.

positiveCases.scenario: Only after the permitted same-thread correction reports and deterministic correction verification still fails, run the separate checked-in reasoning-defect fixture and classify that evidence as an implementation-reasoning defect.
positiveCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify Superpowers, start a new Codex task, complete the semantic-repair procedure above, require a failed correction verification, and use submission/fixtures/implementation-reasoning-failure.json without changes.

evidenceInjection.expectedOutput: {"actual":"policy low; reviewer evidence medium after correction","boundary":"routing policy and reviewer contract","classification":"implementation-reasoning defect","expected":"low in both policy and reviewer evidence","fingerprint":"review-fixture-reasoning-v1","invariant":"Balanced bounded implementation uses Low effort across policy and reviewer evidence"}
sequence: Complete the same-thread correction and rerun the exact deterministic verification.
Only if correction verification fails across the canonical policy and reviewer evidence, run the exact command above.
Copy the single output line and exit code 1 into the failure report, preserving the command, fingerprint, classification, boundary, invariant, expected value, and actual value.

positiveCases.expectedWorkflow: Dispatch the single fresh mode-routed debugger.
positiveCases.expectedResult: The trace records the separately classified reasoning-defect fingerprint and the corrective upward transition when effort increases.
positiveCases.rationale: A separate implementation-reasoning defect established after correction failure warrants the one fresh debugger.

positiveCases.scenario: Complete an approved bounded plan and allow Superpowers to run specification review followed by code-quality review without injecting a worker failure.
positiveCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify the requesting-code-review SKILL.md entrypoint, start a new Codex task, approve a small documentation plan, and retain the initial escalation count for comparison after both reviews.
positiveCases.expectedWorkflow: Use each review's planned effort without counting it as an escalation; correct and re-review any finding through the Superpowers workflow.
positiveCases.expectedResult: Worker status remains separate from each downstream review gate and the escalation count is unchanged.
positiveCases.rationale: Planned reviews are workflow gates, not corrective escalation.

negativeCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify Superpowers, start a new Codex task at the checkout root, and send the prompt before approving any implementation plan.
negativeCases.expectedResult: Normal Superpowers design work occurs with no Adaptive Effort worker or routing trace.
negativeCases.safeFallback: Finish design and obtain explicit plan approval before implementation.

negativeCases.scenario: Attempt an approved-plan implementation after confirming that the required Superpowers SKILL.md entrypoints are absent or disabled.
negativeCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Start a new Codex task without installing Superpowers, inspect the active skill inventory, and record the missing entrypoints before requesting implementation.
negativeCases.expectedResult: A clear prerequisite failure names the missing Superpowers workflow skills and no Adaptive Effort worker runs.
negativeCases.safeFallback: Install Superpowers from its public repository, verify its SKILL.md entrypoints, and start another new Codex task.

negativeCases.scenario: Replay the same fixed public failure fingerprint after the permitted repair and debugger, or request recovery while withholding independent contract/design evidence.
negativeCases.publicSetup: Clone https://github.com/darvilp/adaptive-effort and check out public main. Verify that plugins/adaptive-effort/.codex-plugin/plugin.json reports version 0.1.2. Verify Superpowers, start a new Codex task, use the semantic-repair and fresh-debugger evidence procedure above, then inject the identical command/fingerprint once more without adding independent design evidence.
negativeCases.expectedWorkflow: Do not restart the ladder and do not dispatch recovery without independent evidence.
negativeCases.expectedResult: A bounded stop report records consumed stages and the missing recovery evidence.
negativeCases.safeFallback: Return to the user or planning for new evidence, changed scope, or authority.
